tasks.label: dotfiles: git pull latest main/master
args: set -euo pipefail; branch=$(git branch --show-current); if [ -z "$branch" ]; then echo "Not on a local branch." >&2; exit 1; fi; base=$(git symbolic-ref --quiet --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's#^origin/##' || true); if [ -z "$base" ]; then for candidate in main master; do if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$candidate" >/dev/null 2>&1; then base=$candidate; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$base" ]; then echo "Could not find origin main/master." >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ "$branch" = "$base" ]; then git pull --ff-only --prune origin "$base"; else git fetch --prune origin "$base"; echo "Fetched origin/$base. Current branch is $branch; run the rebase shortcut to rebase onto origin/$base."; fi

tasks.label: dotfiles: git rebase current branch onto main/master
args: set -euo pipefail; branch=$(git branch --show-current); if [ -z "$branch" ]; then echo "Not on a local branch." >&2; exit 1; fi; base=$(git symbolic-ref --quiet --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's#^origin/##' || true); if [ -z "$base" ]; then for candidate in main master; do if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$candidate" >/dev/null 2>&1; then base=$candidate; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$base" ]; then echo "Could not find origin main/master." >&2; exit 1; fi; git fetch --prune origin "$base"; if [ "$branch" = "$base" ]; then git pull --ff-only --prune origin "$base"; else git rebase "origin/$base"; fi
